I answered Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-random: the ticket is **#88412**.

- **Where I found it:** Tobias raised it in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025 as a Tier 2 escalation. The Tansleigh Packaging gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the BOL barcode scan. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so they can see that thread themselves.
- **Not the same as Tansley Parcel:** In that thread, Tobias first wrote "TP" and Priyanka thought he meant Tansley Parcel. He corrected it, so #88412 is the Packaging ticket.
- **Status unknown:** Nothing in that thread says whether the ticket is still open or has been resolved, and I said so in the reply. I couldn't see any account ticket files.

Ticket numbers are operational facts, not finance figures, so no approval was needed.
